0022600152.text: The San Antonio Spurs (3-2, 1-2 at home, 2-0 on the road) host the Minnesota Timberwolves (4-2, 2-1 at home, 2-1 on the road) as the Spurs look to build on a three-game winning streak, while the Spurs sit 8th in the West and the Timberwolves 6th. San Antonio is missing Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf, strain), and Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery), and Rudy Gobert (back, spasms). The teams have not yet met this season, following a 2025-26 regular-season series the Spurs lost 1-2 and a 2025-26 playoff series the Spurs won 4-2, including a 139-109 San Antonio win in Minneapolis on May 15.
